podcast.title: Belief on Price's Departure
podcast.body: Chandler, who shared a flat with Alan Price, believed until his death that Price's sudden departure from The Animals was prompted by the arrival of his first royalty check for "House of the Rising Sun," leading Price to decide against sharing the money. "Chandler believed until his death that while he was in the shower, Price's first royalty check for arranging House of the Rising Sunhood arrived, and Price had decided then and there that he wasn't going to share the money as agreed."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode 115: "House of the Rising Sun" by the Animals

podcast.title: Impressions of Alan Price
podcast.body: Charles Chandler, as the bass player for The Contours, was impressed by Alan Price's playing during some Kansas City 5 rehearsals, which ultimately led to Price being poached by The Contours. "He'd been poached by a pop-covvers band, the Contours, whose bass player, Charles Chandler, had been impressed with him when Chandler had sat in at a couple of Kansas City 5 rehearsals."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode 115: "House of the Rising Sun" by the Animals

podcast.title: Transition to Management
podcast.body: Charles Chandler later transitioned from playing bass to a career in music management, with further details to be discussed in future episodes. "We'll be picking up with Charles Chandler later, when he moves from bass playing into management, so you'll hear more about him in future episodes."
